[[Murakai's Maul]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] obtained from [[Murakai's Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Murakai, Lady of the Night]] in [[Cathedral of Flames]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]]: -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ivory Hammer]].
